title: kbmon heads its view and status answer with one line of what needs the operator
goal: mon_needs builds from one snapshot the list of what waits on the operator: each open operator gate (sprint and gate), each blocked sprint (active with items left and none ready), a refused delivery, each real orphan, disk under 10% free and a checkout that cannot fast-forward with why; the text view prints it as one needs you line under the header (needs you: nothing when empty), and kbmon --status all starts with the same line

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
k=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180,env=dict(os.environ,COLUMNS='400'))
snap=json.loads(k('--json').stdout);P=snap['panels']
for n in ('sprint','querylog','sessions','host'):P[n]={'state':'ok','seconds':0.1,'data':P[n].get('data') or {}}
sp=P['sprint']['data'];sp['sprints']=[{'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','state':'active','title':'A blocked plant sprint','items':{'todo':2},'next':None,'next_title':None,
    'open':[{'id':'ST-bbbbbbbb','title':'Plant item','status':'todo'}],'done_at':[],'waiting':[{'item':'ST-bbbbbbbb','gate':'g-plant'}]}]
sp['fast_forward']={'can':False,'why':'2 tracked files with local changes: README.md, AGENTS.md'};sp['behind']=4;sp['source']='origin/main';sp['landings']=[]
P['querylog']['data']['last_delivery']={'outcome':'refused','why':'gate lint failed','when':'2026-10-19T08:00:00Z'}
P['sessions']['data']['procs']=[{'pid':4242,'age_s':7200,'class':'orphan','checkout':'wt9','session':None,'item':None}]
P['host']['data']['disk']={'free_bytes':5*10**9,'total_bytes':100*10**9,'free_pct':5.0}
f=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'s.json');json.dump(snap,open(f,'w'))
once=k('--once','--from-snapshot',f).stdout.splitlines();st=k('--status','all','--from-snapshot',f).stdout.splitlines()
nl=[l for l in once[:6] if l.lower().startswith('needs you')];print(nl[:1],st[:1])
ok=len(nl)==1 and all(w in nl[0] for w in ('g-plant','blocked','refused','orphan','disk','fast-forward')) and bool(st) and st[0]==nl[0]
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
